Fix Android translations receiving only the first word of an expanded paragraph selection.

- Read the native selection handles through the registered CodeMirror editor's DOM-to-source mapping, even if Obsidian's cursor API still reports the initial word.
- Preserve the expanded native range when opening the command palette or toolbar; a stale API subset no longer replaces it.
- Resolve the selection when Translate is clicked instead of freezing it when the long-press menu first opens.
- Track editor selection updates and retain exact multiline/source positions. Selections outside the note or in another editor are ignored.

**Validation:** TypeScript check, production build, and all 38 regression tests passed. Two integration tests use actual CodeMirror editor DOMs in jsdom to verify full-paragraph command-palette translation and exact repeated/multiline positions. Obsidian and translation API responses are mocked; Android physical-device retesting of this fix is still needed.

Update the plugin to **1.2.1**, select a paragraph in editing mode, then run **Translate selection** from the command palette. The Original text field should contain the entire selection. Windows uses the same plugin files. Preserve existing `data.json` settings when updating manually.

---

修复 Android 上选中整段话后，从命令面板翻译却只识别第一个单词的问题。

- 读取选区手柄对应的实际笔记范围，保留最新的整段选区。
- 打开命令面板或工具栏时，避免旧的单词选区覆盖整段选区。
- 长按菜单中的 Translate 也会在点击时重新读取最新选区。
- 保持多行及重复文字的位置准确，保留 Windows 支持。

类型检查、生产构建和 38 项回归测试通过，其中包含实际 CodeMirror DOM 的集成验证；Android 真机效果仍需复测。

请在手机第三方插件中更新至 **1.2.1**，按原来的方式选中整段并调用命令。翻译框的 Original text 应显示整段文字。无需重新设置密钥或云环境。
